title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Run data queries with MCP Server (no APIs required)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces Data Query Tools for the MCP Server, enabling AI agents to define, validate, and run custom data queries without requiring pre-existing APIs. This capability allows agents to perform ad-hoc joins and aggregates on Business Central data through four new system tools.
key_points: Data Query Tools is a new preview feature that adds system tools for compiling and running AL data queries submitted by MCP clients
Four new system tools are available: bc_data_find_tables, bc_data_get_table_relations, bc_data_get_table_schema, and bc_data_query
Data query tools are read-only and prevent agents from creating, modifying, or deleting data
The feature is managed through a new Server Features tab on the MCP Server Configuration page

quotes.text: Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit of data query tools - accessing data that lacks pre-built APIs

quotes.text: Data query tools are read-only and don't allow agents to create, modify, or delete data.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical for understanding security constraints and safe data access patterns

quotes.text: agents who use your MCP server configuration have access to data query tools they can use in their workflows.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how agents gain capability to compose custom queries through the MCP server
